hero.title: Open ERP
hero.subtitle: Streamline your business operations with a modern, extensible platform built for growth. Open-source, secure, and designed for you.

features.title: Everything you need to run your business
features.subtitle: From products to reports, Open ERP has you covered with a clean, intuitive interface.

inventory.title: Products & Inventory
inventory.description: Full product management with stock tracking, barcodes, categories, and multi-warehouse inventory with Kardex movement records.

hr.title: HR & Payroll
hr.description: Complete human resources module with employee management, attendance tracking, payroll processing, loans, bonuses, and leave management.

pos.title: Sales & POS
pos.description: Create invoices, track payments, and manage your point of sale with quick-sale interface, product search, and electronic DTE document generation.

accounting.title: Accounting & Reports
accounting.description: Hierarchical chart of accounts, company configuration with El Salvador DTE compliance, and real-time dashboard analytics.

analytics.title: Real-time Analytics
analytics.desc: Monitor your business performance with live dashboards, custom reports, and actionable insights that help you make data-driven decisions.

secure.title: Secure & Reliable
secure.desc: Enterprise-grade security with JWT authentication, encrypted data storage, and role-based access control to keep your data safe.

fast.title: Lightning Fast
fast.desc: Optimized performance with server-side rendering, automatic caching, and a modern tech stack that ensures fast load times.

opensource.title: Open Source
opensource.desc: Fully open-source. Self-host or use our cloud. Customize, extend, and contribute to the platform.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of businesses using Open ERP to streamline their operations. It's free, open-source, and built for you.

screenshots.subtitle: Clean, modern interface for every business module
